reasoning: The package is a standard AUR packaging for the UE4SS mod loader. It fetches a pinned release archive from the project's own GitHub repository with valid SHA256 checksums. The included helper script (ue4ss-install) safely deploys the payload to user-specified game directories without network access or obfuscation. The only 'inconclusive' result was due to a transient API error (HTTP 400) in one model, not a security finding.
disagreement_analysis: The initial trigger for disagreement was caused by a tool error (HTTP 400 API failure) in the qwen model when auditing the PKGBUILD, resulting in an 'inconclusive' verdict. The deepseek model successfully audited all files and found them safe. The openrouter report is marked as advisory and also found it safe. There is no substantive disagreement on the security merits of the package.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit the PKGBUILD due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError), resulting in an inconclusive file verdict.
learnings: Transient LLM API errors (e.g., HTTP 400) should be retried or clearly separated from security verdicts to prevent a single file's tool failure from cascading into an overall 'inconclusive' package verdict.
